title: LA Colossal – Maki-e 04 (Seated)
prompt:
Fine art body painting photography. Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Japanese woman in her late 30s, black hair in a low bun with a lacquer comb, natural face with a knowing smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips filling the armchair, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body maki-e lacquer body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. The body painting is the only covering on the body — no garments, no fabric, no kimono, no robes, no bodysuit, no leggings, no stockings. Deep glossy black urushi with fine sprinkled gold dust forming irises, a wooden bridge, and flowing water, crisp raised gold relief. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated in a low black lacquer armchair, torso turned open toward the camera, one forearm on the armrest, the other hand on her thigh, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Towering 9-inch black lacquer peep-toe platform stilettos with a single gold ankle strap.
Nails: Extra long oval nails, black with gold powder tips.

Background & Lighting: Lacquer artist's studio with half-finished boxes and brushes, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm window light with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
